episode_summary: In this episode, Vija Williams discusses the evolving role of real estate agents in the post-AI era, emphasizing the importance of engaging with sellers early through cash offer leads. She highlights the need for agents to become problem solvers and consultants, offering multiple sales strategies to meet the needs of today's educated consumers.
